SET LOCAL ROLE hmi_migrator
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(843001)
DO $$ BEGIN IF (SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version) <> '0014_mixed_alarm_runtime' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected schema revision'; END IF; END $$

CREATE TABLE analog_history_clock_state (
        source_id text NOT NULL, stream_id text NOT NULL, gateway_id text NOT NULL,
        capture_generation numeric(20,0) NOT NULL, clock_epoch text NOT NULL,
        last_seq numeric(20,0) NOT NULL, last_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        reversal_seq numeric(20,0),
        PRIMARY KEY(source_id,stream_id,gateway_id,capture_generation,clock_epoch),
        FOREIGN KEY(source_id,stream_id) REFERENCES source_streams(source_id,stream_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE TABLE analog_history_raw (
        line_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        source_id text NOT NULL, stream_id text NOT NULL,
        gateway_id text NOT NULL,
        capture_generation numeric(20,0) NOT NULL CHECK
            (capture_generation BETWEEN 0 AND 18446744073709551615),
        capture_seq numeric(20,0) NOT NULL CHECK
            (capture_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 18446744073709551615),
        tag_id text NOT NULL, sample_id text NOT NULL, acquired_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        stored_at timestamptz NOT NULL, batch_id text NOT NULL, observation jsonb NOT NULL,
        clock_assessment jsonb NOT NULL, aggregated boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        PRIMARY KEY (source_id,stream_id,gateway_id,capture_generation,capture_seq,tag_id),
        UNIQUE (source_id,stream_id,sample_id),
        FOREIGN KEY (source_id,stream_id) REFERENCES source_streams(source_id,stream_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

CREATE INDEX ix_analog_history_raw_lookup ON analog_history_raw
        (line_id,source_id,stream_id,tag_id,acquired_at)

CREATE INDEX ix_analog_history_raw_cleanup ON analog_history_raw
        (LEAST(acquired_at,stored_at))

CREATE INDEX ix_analog_history_raw_pending ON analog_history_raw
        (line_id,source_id,stream_id,acquired_at) WHERE NOT aggregated

CREATE TABLE analog_history_minutes (
        line_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        source_id text NOT NULL, stream_id text NOT NULL, tag_id text NOT NULL,
        minute timestamptz NOT NULL CHECK (minute=date_trunc('minute',minute)),
        policy_version text NOT NULL, point jsonb NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(line_id,source_id,stream_id,tag_id,minute,policy_version),
        FOREIGN KEY (source_id,stream_id) REFERENCES source_streams(source_id,stream_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )
CREATE INDEX ix_analog_history_minutes_cleanup ON analog_history_minutes(minute)

CREATE TABLE downtime_reason_history (
        id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        line_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, stream_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        segment_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, segment_to TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        reason_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason_code IN
            ('MATERIAL_WAIT','EQUIPMENT','CHANGEOVER','PLANNED','UNCLASSIFIED')),
        note TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(note)<=200),
        actor TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        original_intent JSONB NOT NULL, receipt JSONB NOT NULL,
        CHECK(segment_to > segment_from)
    )

CREATE INDEX ix_downtime_reason_scope ON downtime_reason_history
        (execution_id,line_id,source_id,stream_id,segment_from,id DESC)

CREATE FUNCTION immutable_downtime_reason() RETURNS trigger
        LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Downtime annotation audit and receipts are immutable'; END $$

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_downtime_reason
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON downtime_reason_history FOR EACH ROW
        EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_downtime_reason()

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_downtime_reason_truncate
        BEFORE TRUNCATE ON downtime_reason_history FOR EACH STATEMENT
        EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_downtime_reason()
CREATE TABLE guest_viewer_accounts (login TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT CHECK (login='guest-viewer'), provisioned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE guest_rate_windows (peer_digest BYTEA PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(peer_digest)=32), window_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 6))
ALTER TABLE auth_audit DROP CONSTRAINT auth_audit_action_check
ALTER TABLE auth_audit ADD CONSTRAINT auth_audit_action_check CHECK (action IN ('user_bootstrapped','login_succeeded','password_changed','session_revoked','roles_changed','active_changed','GUEST'))
UPDATE alembic_version SET version_num='0017_guest_viewer' WHERE version_num='0014_mixed_alarm_runtime'
